title: Clinical Microbiology
description: Support routine culture and antimicrobial susceptibility testing with Liofilchem culture media and AST products from Italy. BioAzure serves referral labs, hospitals and research institutions with pan-India cold-chain distribution.

title: Molecular Diagnostics
description: Source Sacace PCR kits and ViennaLab StripAssay genotyping products for molecular testing workflows. BioAzure connects diagnostic and research laboratories across India with these Italian and Austrian product portfolios.

title: Food Safety & Testing
description: Explore phage-based food safety solutions with PhageGuard from Micreos, Netherlands. BioAzure helps food companies source these products for targeted bacterial control in food processing applications.

title: IVD Raw Materials
description: Source Medix Biochemica IVD raw materials and Candor Bioscience immunoassay optimization products for assay development and manufacturing. BioAzure serves Indian IVD manufacturers and R&D teams through a dedicated global supplier portfolio.
